decisions.reason: First-use footnote for jiazi is warranted; the term is not self-explanatory to English readers.
정인 is a literary beloved, not casual plural lovers; SOL keeps the wistful register.
The contraction marks the boy's 반말 against the later polite line, which the candy joke depends on.
곰마워 is baby-talk for 고마워; Tank you preserves the child's mispronunciation that Thank you drops.
타탁 on a fire-starter is a light click, not a crack; a period mutes the SFX beat.
코딱지만 한 is the narrator's crude size-image; tiny village flattens it. [^2] follows the new jiazi note.
처먹다 is greedy gobbling, not neutral eat; stuff his face matches 저 새끼 and the scorn.
코를 훌쩍이며 is a wet sniffle, not sniffed, which can read as smelling.
쩌어어기 is a drawn-out 저기; Waaay over there keeps the child's stretched pointing.
가서 아니면 어쩌려고 objects to going first; BASE drops the wasted-trip 가서.
저놈의 is that bastard's, which BASE omits; chuck also fits 확 내팽개치다 and Taekyung's voice.
대동단결 is slogan-unity, not united everyone; Grandpas, united as one keeps the ironic set phrase.
살코기 and 덕지덕지 붙은 are in the source; lingering desire plastered on his face beats generic regretful gaze.
Needed once jiazi is footnoted in P14; clan-village note stays as [^2].
